title: Peer feedback: tarteel in Surahs 74 and 75: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Peer feedback rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 35. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

questions.q: The teacher recites 75:22 to 25 with two errors. Write precise feedback for each.
questions.a: For example: '75:22: نَّاضِرَةٌ needs the covered ض'; '75:25: تَظُنُّ needs itbaq on ظ'.

questions.q: Peer rounds in breakout rooms (threes): each pupil recites a section of 74 or 75; the others mark the rubric and write feedback in the portal response box.
questions.a: Three completed rubric sheets with precise targets.

questions.q: Extend: practise your target three times and record yourself (voice only) for the teacher.
Which pace is slowest, used for learning?
questions.a: A) Tahqiq. Tahqiq is the slowest and most careful pace.
the quickest pace with rules kept
options: the quickest pace with rules kept

questions.q: Think again: What is the difference between reciting fast and reciting with tarteel?
questions.a: Tarteel is measured: every letter, madd and stop is given its right; speed can come later.
